analysis.rationale: Single-step glass blur severity 2. Blur DT: anisotropy=1.244<1.7 (not motion); glass_score=0.505>0.25 and 0.466 (pair1) indicates pixel-shuffle HF residual. Severity scan via PSNR peak + CI: glass2 = 34.66/28.44/38.91 dB on pairs 0/1/2, all CI 10/10 with every content-independent metric diff <= 0.004; glass1 (8/10), glass3 (9/10 pair0), glass5 (8/10) all worse. PSNR <40 is expected: helper.shuffle_pixels_njit uses seedless np.random so exact pixels cannot be reproduced. Independent cross-check: run_full_analysis on the glass:2 simulation reproduces the target's full signal fingerprint (sigma 1.5 vs 1.48; variance_ratio 0.868 vs 0.869; mean_shift -0.5; glass_score 0.50 vs 0.505; block_boundary 1.001 vs 1.002). Ruled out: JPEG (block_boundary~1.0, 0%FP), global (variance explained content-dependently by blur; mean_shift -0.5/255<0.005), noise (wavelet sigma content-dependent 1.48/4.08/0.37; impulse_total_pct diff 0), motion blur (anisotropy<1.7).
